inputs.prompt: Image 2 is a coloured stick-figure pose skeleton. Draw the woman from image 1 standing in that exact pose, at the same size and position in the frame as the skeleton, with empty background around her: her whole figure fits inside the frame, hair, both shoes and both hands fully visible with margin on every side. Irish step dancing, upright with both arms held straight and rigid down at her sides, the hands in fists against the skirt, up on the balls of the feet with the feet crossed, turned a little toward the right of the picture, a small crisp nod in time while watching. Sides are her own: she faces the viewer, so her left is on the right of the picture. She keeps her slim, upright, athletic young adult build with long straight legs, an oval face with a few freckles, fair skin, copper-red hair pulled up in a neat high round bun with a small silver clover pin, a long-sleeved dark green velvet dress with a high round neck, a fitted bodice and a stiff flared skirt reaching the knee, silver knotwork embroidery on the bodice, cuffs and hem, black opaque tights, black leather hard shoes with thick heels and small silver buckles, and thick dark ink outline, exactly as in image 1. Same pixel art style with crisp pixel clusters and cel shading. She has exactly two arms and two hands, each hand complete with fingers. She is a grown woman of about twenty-five. Both eyes are open. Her mouth is closed in a cool, composed expression. Her dress closes high at the neck, its sleeves reach her wrists, and its skirt covers her to the knee. Do not draw the skeleton. Plain light grey background, full body.
